# @pyrito-ai/design-api-client

Typed client for the frozen v1 API of `pyrito-design-server`.

Generated from `openapi/v1.yaml` by `npm run generate:client` in that repo. Do
not edit `src/` by hand: edit the spec and regenerate. CI re-runs the generator
and fails if this directory differs.

```ts
import { DesignApiClient, ConflictError } from '@pyrito-ai/design-api-client';

const client = new DesignApiClient({ baseUrl: '/' }); // browser: same origin
await client.login({ body: { email, password } });

try {
  await client.putDocumentBundle({
    workspaceId,
    documentId,
    baseContentRevision: known,
    body: bytes,
  });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof ConflictError) {
    // Re-fetch, rebase on error.expected, retry. Never retry with the same base.
  }
}
```

No hostname is baked in: `baseUrl` and `fetch` are both supplied by the caller.
The full protocol — auth flow, `409` recovery, the `422` code table — is in
`docs/api-v1.md` of the server repo.
